description_en: Queries a list of image animation jobs
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-dynamic-image-jobs --start-of-create-time 2022-07-12T00:00:00Z --end-of-create-time 2022-07-14T00:00:00Z --status Success --order-by CreateTimeDesc --job-id 0000cdb3e74639973036bc840000 --page-size 20 --next-page-token cdb3e74639973036bc84 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDynamicImageJobs

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间
parameters.name: start_of_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which the jobs to be queried were created
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间
parameters.name: end_of_create_time

parameters.help_en:
The state of the job.

Valid values:

Init: The job is submitted.

Success: The job is successful.

Fail: The job failed
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The order that you use to sort the query results. Valid values:

CreateTimeAsc: sorts the jobs by creation time in ascending order.

CreateTimeDesc: sorts the jobs by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序。取值： 
CreateTimeAsc： 按照创建时间顺序排列
CreateTimeDesc： 按照创建时间逆序排列
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为20，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记
parameters.name: next_page_token

items.description_en: The information about an image animation job

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the job was complete

Media.description_en:
The input file. The file can be an OSS object or a media asset. The URL of an OSS object can be in one of the following formats:

OSS://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object In the URL, bucket specifies an OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the job, and object specifies the object URL in OSS
Media.description_zh:
输入媒体，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为
OSS://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径

Type.description_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

OSS: an Object Storage Service (OSS) object.

Media: a media asset.

-

-
Type.description_zh:
输入类型，取值：

Media：媒资ID

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the job was last modified

Media.description_en:
The input file. If Type is set to OSS, the URL of an OSS object is returned. If Type is set to Media, the ID of a media asset is returned. The URL of an OSS object can be in one of the following formats:

OSS://bucket/object

http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object In the URL, bucket specifies an OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the job, and object specifies the object URL in OSS
Media.description_zh:
输入媒体。当Type为OSS时填入OSS地址，Type为Media时填入媒资ID。
OSS地址规则为：
OSS://bucket/object
http(s)://bucket.oss-[RegionId].aliyuncs.com/object
其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS bucket名称，object为文件路径

Type.description_en:
The type of the output file. Valid values:

OSS: an OSS object.

Media: a media asset.

-
Type.description_zh:
输出类型，取值：

Media：媒资ID
